verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Gemini in Gmail's "Schedule" feature, which proposes meeting times based on the user's Google Calendar availability. That is a thin, first-party calendar-aware capability inside the email client. Workspace add-ons are only a developer building block, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: viewing the calendar inside Gmail, responding to (RSVP) invites from the inbox, creating calendar events from Gmail, in-depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
